text:
emma_marketing: quick sync  goal: announce Tue 10:00 PT. need final changelog link, docs URL, and one-line perf stat for socials by EOD tomorrow. can eng commit? :hourglass:

lee_engineering: changelog PR is up and should land by EOD tomorrow. docs are in draft and need product sign-off. pinging @zara_product

zara_product: i'll review docs today, aim to return comments by 2pm PT. webinar question: keep Wed 11am PT live demo or move after rollout?

emma_marketing: prefer Wed 11am to capture launch momentum. marketing will run email + social in the first 24h.

katie_marketing: i'll draft the newsletter and short social headline once the changelog link is final. need a 280-char perf line.

lee_engineering: perf blurb (draft): "~20% median text-gen latency improvement at 512 tokens; ~25% lower unit cost with default batching + KV cache." use for teaser, blog will include full numbers.

omar_release: rollout plan: canary checks start 09:50 PT, embargo lifts 10:05 PT, full ramp by 12:00 PT. deploy-bot will run prechecks at 09:45 PT.

deploy-bot: Canary job scheduled: start=2026-08-12T09:45:00Z, pool=canary-2, notify=#eng-oncall on failure.

lee_engineering: docs placeholder: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2026-08-infer-update. changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/501

emma_marketing: marketing asks changelog to include a "What this means for you" bullet and a short curl example snippet. can eng add that?

lee_engineering: will add two bullets and this curl example: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"rw1-medium","prompt":"Hello"}'
```

zara_product: for the webinar slides please include one slide on canary + rollback. @omar_release can you give two short rollback triggers?

omar_release: rollback triggers: 1) error rate > 1% sustained for 5 minutes; 2) P95 latency > 2x baseline for 10 minutes. i'll paste exact wording into the shared doc by 4pm PT.

katie_marketing: social copy draft incoming. will post to this thread for an accuracy check before scheduling.

emma_marketing: timeline recap: EOD tomorrow = changelog merged + docs reviewed, 09:45 PT canary precheck, 10:00 PT announce (embargo lift at 10:05 PT), webinar Wed 11am PT. confirm and i'll lock calendar. :white_check_mark:

lee_engineering: confirmed from eng. merging changelog now.

zara_product: confirmed  i'll drop slides to the drive and update here when ready.

katie_marketing: confirmed  will schedule social + newsletter once links are final.

lee_engineering: update: perf numbers adjusted after final run  median improvement is 18% not 20%. updating PR and docs now.

katie_marketing: noted  will use 18% in teaser. schedule unchanged.

emma_marketing: thanks all  final ask: prefix any metric changes with "update:" so marketing doesn't miss edits.
